scripts.test:loopback: for f in tests/shared-daemon-e2e.test.mjs tests/typed-command-loopback-e2e.test.mjs tests/introduction-send.test.mjs tests/rest-e2e.test.mjs; do echo "# $f"; node --import tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:startup && npm run test:offline && npm run test:loopback
